edges.reason: setDelay authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with address(this), so caller identity controls execution.
acceptAdmin compares msg.sender with pendingAdmin and writes msg.sender into admin.
setPendingAdmin authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender with address(this).
queueTransaction requires msg.sender == admin before queueing.
cancelTransaction requires msg.sender == admin before cancelling.
executeTransaction requires msg.sender == admin before performing the external call.
getBlockTimestamp returns the miner-influenced block.timestamp used for all timelock checks.
queueTransaction validates eta against getBlockTimestamp().add(delay), introducing timestamp dependency.
executeTransaction validates maturity and staleness using getBlockTimestamp(), introducing timestamp dependency.
admin state value is the authorization gate for queueTransaction.
admin state value is the authorization gate for cancelTransaction.
admin state value is the authorization gate for executeTransaction.
pendingAdmin state value is the authorization gate for acceptAdmin.
Constructor writes the initial admin address.
Constructor writes the initial delay value.

acceptAdmin sets admin to msg.sender.
acceptAdmin resets pendingAdmin to address(0).
setPendingAdmin writes the nominated pending admin.
queueTransaction marks the transaction hash as queued in queuedTransactions.
cancelTransaction marks the transaction hash as false in queuedTransactions.
executeTransaction clears queuedTransactions[txHash] before the external call.
receiveETH writes the supplied message into Mock.message.
Current delay value is read when validating eta in queueTransaction.
GRACE_PERIOD bounds the accepted execution window in executeTransaction.
